UserRegistration.title: UserRegistration
UserRegistration.description: Represents a registered Tandis customer or specialist/guild provider profile stored on the cloud server.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the registered user.

fullName.description: Full name of the registered user or specialist.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone number entered during registration.

accountType.description: Role selected in registration step 1: customer or specialist/guild provider.

guildCategory.description: Primary service/guild category for specialists or empty string for regular customers.

nationalCode.description: 10-digit national ID or guild license code for verification.

bio.description: Short description of services or customer notes.

isRegistrationComplete.description: Whether all registration steps have been completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when registration was created (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when registration was last updated (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserListing.title: UserListing
UserListing.description: A classified ad or service listing created by an authenticated Tandis user.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the listing owner.

categoryId.description: Category identifier (real_estate, vehicles, market, legal, etc.).

categoryTitle.description: Display title of the category in Persian.

phone.description: Contact phone number for the listing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the listing was created (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the listing was updated (clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores the multi-step registration record and profile for each authenticated Tandis user.

/users/{userId}/listings/{listingId}.description: Stores classified listings created by the authenticated user.
